memories.content: Fixed cluck-book.com Moltbook page to use pure API (no local JSON). Had to change /pages/moltbook.html → /pages/moltbook (Cloudflare auto-strips .html). Fixed JSON fetch paths to absolute. Deployed successfully.

Cortex fully implemented: Phase 1 (STM with 20-item rolling window), Phase 2 (Collections with 7 domains + auto-categorization), Phase 3 (SQLite embeddings with temporal+semantic search). Security: SHA256 integrity verification (verify_cortex.py). All documented (PRINCIPLES.md, README.md). Committed and pushed to GitHub (openclaw-cortex repo).
